Tidewatch

Tidewatch is a small command-line tool that prints the next high and low water times for a harbour. It is a synthetic README written for the Send to X3 test suite.

Installation

pip install tidewatch
tidewatch --harbour "Gull Rock"

Configuration

Settings live in ~/.config/tidewatch.toml:

[harbour]
name = "Gull Rock"
    offset_minutes = 12
OptionMeaning
nameHarbour to report
offset_minutesLocal correction

Supported harbours

  • Gull Rock
  • Saltmarsh Quay
    • inner basin
    • outer basin
